evidence_rules: Evidence IDs (E-xx) are bound to a specific record version: the same E-ID in different record versions may denote different content. Content identity is the combination record_version + evidence_id + sha256. An ID whose content is reclassified is not reused with a new meaning: E-09 (src/pilot_calibration.py) was evidence in record versions 1-4 and is a disclosure (not evidence) in this version.

controls.description: Block permutation of the target series (7-day blocks, seeds 1..5) of the DAILY dataset: alignment between target and all exogenous/calendar features is destroyed; the clean pipeline is rebuilt and re-run on the permuted data; the verdict procedure must not issue PASS
controls.note: rejections = false PASS on null data. Zero is published together with the Wilson CI and the conservative rule-of-three upper bound (~60% at 0/5). Naive point-shuffle of labels is not used anywhere in this record (invalid on trended data: it destroys the trend/seasonal structure and produces miscalibrated nulls)
